name: Safety Net
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach the prevention window. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Coalescence and two Pressure Spike for three Telework Contract and a Creative Commission. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6b: two Burner for the two Jailbreak, a run on HQ for a run on HQ or R&D.
